plugins.name: furiosa
plugins.description: Git commit messages (커밋 메시지), PR creation/updates (PR 만들어줘), commit history cleanup (히스토리 정리), and automated technical documentation with accuracy tracking (자동 코드 문서화). Triggers: 'commit message', 'create PR', 'update PR', 'restructure commits', 'prepare documentation', 'write documentation', 'update docs from PR'.
